text:
The builder is likely to recover $10,000, since the homeowner's wrongful stop makes the builder's claim rest on unjust enrichment, capped at the benefit conferred rather than the contract expectation. The $3,000 increase in property value does not set the measure here; the builder's incurred costs of $9,000 framing plus $1,000 in unincorporated materials total $10,000.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
